body.objective: Adopt the short external-interest Phase 2 as the forward programme, encode its outcome-independent closure rule and theory-admission gate, and publish small dependency-safe work packages for CPT feasibility, general Schwarzschild asymptotics, and compact-background sign robustness.
body.stop_condition: The Phase-2 interest brief is committed; the authoritative roadmap names P2-A through P2-E, their exact scopes, nonclaims, sequence and closure rule; initial work items are registered with disjoint producer paths and split before large shortfall risk; the CPT negative control, axial and polar Schwarzschild coefficient rails, and direct-product family map are READY for short-lived subagents; the launch report records how subagents replace persistent resident sessions without weakening leases, provenance or independent verification.
body.current_gate: Short Phase-2 launch and subagent pilot
body.forbid: no new changed theory; no reopening Phase 1; no arbitrary-support bounded-cone or standard-matter anomaly census priority; no full scattering requirement at the first Schwarzschild gate; no arbitrary positive eta called a Mannheim C operator; no anomaly called contour-prescription independent; no paper theorem promotion before certificates land
body.resource_hint: Coordination-only launch. Use short-lived subagents for disjoint bounded investigations; the coordinator owns synthesis and commits through an isolated index.
notes: Phase 2 is selected for external scientific interest, not as a promise of a viable theory.
The stretch Hadamard result is not part of the closure condition.
